steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.along: Singing along, the app plays the melody with you as a guide. Use headphones, so the microphone hears only you. Without them, turn off the guide melody and sing with the beat; the metronome can keep it for you.
steps.guided: Sing along with the guide: slide from note to note, up and back down.
steps.steady: Hold each note steady until its end: a long, even tone that doesn’t wobble. The results show how steady you were.
